title: Sources: Oracle leads the race to sell "air-gapped" cloud services to Japan that the US says are key to secure intelligence sharing between Tokyo and its allies (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: Oracle leads the race to sell “air-gapped” cloud services to Japan that the US says are key to secure intelligence sharing between Tokyo and its allies — Larry Ellison's group proposes ‘air-gapped’ network as US pressures Tokyo to tighten security of sensitive data
contentText:

Sources: Oracle leads the race to sell “air-gapped” cloud services to Japan that the US says are key to secure intelligence sharing between Tokyo and its allies   —  Larry Ellison's group proposes ‘air-gapped’ network as US pressures Tokyo to tighten security of sensitive data
